title: Maikura Paxels
description: Adds Paxels that combine pickaxe, axe, and shovel functionality into a single tool.
body:
# Maikura Paxels

Maikura Paxels adds multi-purpose Paxels to Minecraft.

A Paxel combines the functionality of a pickaxe, axe, and shovel into a single tool, allowing you to carry fewer tools while exploring, building, and gathering resources.

## Available Materials

* Wooden Paxel
* Stone Paxel
* Copper Paxel
* Iron Paxel
* Golden Paxel
* Diamond Paxel
* Netherite Paxel
* Beacon Paxel

## Features

### Multi-Purpose Tool

Each Paxel can perform the actions of:

* Pickaxe
* Axe
* Shovel

This makes inventory management simpler and reduces the number of tools you need to carry.

### Vanilla Progression

Paxels follow Minecraft's normal progression path:

Wood → Stone → Copper → Iron → Gold → Diamond → Netherite

### Netherite Upgrade Support

Diamond Paxels can be upgraded using the standard Netherite Smithing Template system.

### Beacon Paxel

The Beacon Paxel is a special end-game tool made from Maikura materials, providing a prestigious upgrade beyond traditional equipment.

## Compatibility

* Minecraft 1.21.11
* Fabric Loader
* Fabric API
